subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should unconfigured memory_search managers get a default periodic sync fallback, or should periodic sync stay opt-in while watcher reliability is handled another way?
rationale: Current source supports the stale-index failure mode, but the obvious fix changes default background sync behavior for existing users, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Accept default-on fallback after repair
options.body: Merge the linked PR once the dirty mark is scoped to memory-source managers and maintainers explicitly accept the 30-minute default interval tradeoff.

options.title: Keep fallback opt-in
options.body: Leave intervalMinutes at 0 by default and document or surface intervalMinutes: 30 as the workaround for long-running gateways with unreliable watchers.

options.title: Choose watcher health/restart instead
options.body: Keep the default unchanged and require a watcher liveness, restart, or warning mechanism as the canonical fix path.

recommendation.title: Accept default-on fallback after repair
recommendation.body: Merge the linked PR once the dirty mark is scoped to memory-source managers and maintainers explicitly accept the 30-minute default interval tradeoff.
